❯ Skip any progress report. Write one plain paragraph of about 120 words
  about rivers, and nothing else.

⏺ Rivers are large streams of fresh water. They flow from high places to
  low places. Water runs downhill under gravity. Rivers begin at springs
  or mountain peaks. Rain and melted snow feed rivers. The water flows
  down valleys and creates channels. Rivers carry soil and rocks. This
  material moves to lower ground. Rivers meet oceans or lakes at their
  ends. Some rivers split into deltas. Deltas have many small branches.
  Humans use rivers for water, food, and power. We build dams to stop
  water flow. These dams make lakes and generate electricity. Boats travel
  on some rivers for trade. Rivers shape the land over long time periods.
  Erosion from flowing water cuts deep valleys. Rivers support many
  plants and animals. Fish live in rivers and lay eggs there. Wetlands
  near rivers hold water and protect soil.
